title: Fractal Earthbending
body:
Command the earth itself with nine powerful abilities focused on terrain manipulation, area control, and battlefield lockdown.

Abilities:

Rock Throw — Select up to four earth blocks with shift-tap, then punch to launch them as projectiles
Earth Wall — Raise a protective wall from the ground, then punch to push it forward as a battering ram
Spikes — Erupt nearby earth into damaging spikes that knock back enemies. Hold shift while looking at an entity to root them in place with earth shackles (5 chi/sec drain)
Rupture — Tear a path of earth forward 8 blocks, launching debris at enemies
Erode — Hold shift to erode earth blocks into sand (1 chi/block), or punch for a 3×3×3 area erode (9 chi)
Sand Blast — Launch nearby sand blocks in a fan pattern
Quicksand — Trap entities in a 3×3×3 sand zone, drag them underground with shift, and eject them on release
Earth Pedestal — Consume earth from below you or your inventory to raise a pedestal and launch yourself upward
Earth Flight — Hold shift to dig downward or fly through the air, requiring earth nearby to start
Earth benders also take reduced fall damage when standing on earth blocks.


/b choose

Requires Fractal Bending Core.
